dimensions.assessment: Affects rural water system operators, public water systems/treatment works serving rural areas, and specifically systems serving fewer than 3,300 people.
dimensions.evidence: eligible entities in accordance with this subsection... own or operate public water systems or treatment works that serve fewer than 3,300 people

dimensions.assessment: Provides federal financial assistance for digital infrastructure, software acquisition, cybersecurity training, and workforce development in rural water utilities.
dimensions.evidence: assisting an eligible entity in designing, constructing, operating, and maintaining digital infrastructure technology

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of $50,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031 (totaling $250,000,000).
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Administrator to carry out the program $50,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a new EPA grant program and requires a Comptroller General digital transformation study and report.
dimensions.evidence: The Administrator shall establish a grant program to provide infrastructure assistance to eligible entities

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes funding through 2031 with funds remaining available until expended, plus a study and report due by December 31, 2030.
dimensions.evidence: for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2031, to remain available until expended

missing_information: Exact number of rural water systems that will successfully apply for and receive grants
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes an EPA grant program authorized at $50,000,000 annually for fiscal years 2027 through 2031 to fund digital infrastructure technology for rural water systems and treatment works, alongside a mandated GAO study and report.
